newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse freezes share prices of two firms.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse freezes share prices of two firms.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Friday froze the share price of Itogon-Suyoc Mining Inc and Acoje Holdings Inc for the second straight day.

The PSE surveillance department said that Itogon A shares were frozen in early trade when the price reached 9.25 centavos, a 48 percent increase from 6.25 centavos, while Itogon B shares were frozen at 9.75, a 50 percent hike from 6.5 centavos
Then, the PSE stopped Acoje shares from gaining further at 36 centavos, a 12 centavo or 46.94 percent increase.

On Thursday, the share prices of Acoje were stopped at 25 centavos after a 48.48 percent surge. Itogon A shares were frozen at 6.25 centavos or a 45.35 percent increase along with Itogon B shares after they reached 6.5 centavos, or 47.73 percent.

The PSE automatically freezes shares when their prices surge by close to 50 percent within a single day. For the rest of the day, the shares can only be traded at or below the price at which they were frozen.
The Manila bourse said the two firms have not responded yet to the stock exchange's questions as to why their share prices have been increasing.

Traders earlier said rumours of backdoor listings, buy-ins and and joint ventures have been propping up the share prices of tertiary stocks in recent days. The rumours were either unconfirmed or denied.
